pin4.off()

pin4.close()

import time
import RPLCD
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO

# Set up the LCD display
lcd = RPLCD.i2c(port=1, address=0x27)

# Set up the PCF8574
pcf = RPLCD.PCF8574(lcd, 0x20)

# Set up the GPIO pins
GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(18, GPIO.IN)
GPIO.setup(23, GPIO.IN)
GPIO.setup(24, GPIO.IN)

# Define the function to read the values from the PCF8574
def read_values():
    try:
        # Read the values from the PCF8574
        values = pcf.read_values()
        # Print the values to the LCD display
        lcd.write(f"{values[0]:02X} {values[1]:02X} {values[2]:02X}")
    except RPLCD.PCF8574Error as e:
        # If there is an error, print the error message
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        # Exit the program with a non-zero status
        exit(1)

# Define the function to release the hardware resources
def release_hardware():
    # Release the GPIO pins
    GPIO.cleanup()
    # Release the LCD display
    lcd.release()

# Set up the interrupt handler
def interrupt_handler(signal, frame):
    # Release the hardware resources
    release_hardware()
    # Exit the program with a non-zero status
    exit(1)

# Set up the signal handler
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupt_handler)

# Main program loop
while True:
    # Read the values from the PCF8574
    read_values()
    # Sleep for 1 second
    time.sleep(1)

import paho.mqtt.client as mqtt

# Initialize the OLED display
oled = luma.oled(128, 64)

# Initialize the camera
camera = picamera2.PiCamera2()

# Initialize the MQTT client
client = mqtt.Client()
client.connect("localhost")

# Set the topic to publish to
topic = "raspberrypi/temperature"

# Set the valid temperature range
valid_range = (0, 40)

# Set the update interval
update_interval = 2

# Set the exit flag
exit_flag = False

def on_message(client, userdata, msg):
    # Parse the message
    try:
        temperature = float(msg.payload)
    except ValueError:
        print("Invalid temperature value:", msg.payload)
        return

    # Check if the temperature is within the valid range
    if not valid_range[0] <= temperature <= valid_range[1]:
        print("Temperature out of range:", temperature)
        return

    # Display the temperature on the OLED display
    oled.text(f"Temperature: {temperature:.1f}°C", 0, 0)

    # Publish the temperature to the MQTT broker
    client.publish(topic, temperature)

def on_interrupt(signal, frame):
    # Set the exit flag
    global exit_flag
    exit_flag = True

# Set the interrupt handler
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, on_interrupt)

# Main loop
while not exit_flag:
    # Take a picture with the camera
    camera.capture("image.jpg")

    # Read the temperature from the camera
    temperature = camera.temperature

    # Check if the temperature is within the valid range
    if not valid_range[0] <= temperature <= valid_range[1]:
        print("Temperature out of range:", temperature)
        continue

    # Display the temperature on the OLED display
    oled.text(f"Temperature: {temperature:.1f}°C", 0, 0)

    # Publish the temperature to the MQTT broker
    client.publish(topic, temperature)

    # Wait for the update interval
    time.sleep(update_interval)

# Release the hardware resources
oled.cleanup()
camera.close()
client.disconnect()

# Exit the program

import smbus2
import time

# Define the I2C address of the MPU6050
MPU6050_ADDR = 0x68

# Define the I2C bus number
I2C_BUS = 1

# Define the I2C device
device = smbus2.SMBus(I2C_BUS)

# Define the MPU6050 registers
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_XOUT_L = 0x3C
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_YOUT_L = 0x3E
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
ACCEL_ZOUT_L = 0x40
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41
TEMP_OUT_L = 0x42
GYRO_XOUT_H = 0x43
GYRO_XOUT_L = 0x44
GYRO_YOUT_H = 0x45
GYRO_YOUT_L = 0x46
GYRO_ZOUT_H = 0x47
GYRO_ZOUT_L = 0x48

# Define the MPU6050 data structure
class MPU6050Data:
    def __init__(self):
        self.accel_x = 0
        self.accel_y = 0
        self.accel_z = 0
        self.temp = 0
        self.gyro_x = 0
        self.gyro_y = 0
        self.gyro_z = 0

# Define the MPU6050 read function
def read_mpu6050(device, addr):
    # Read the MPU6050 data
    data = MPU6050Data()
    data.accel_x = device.read_word_data(addr, ACCEL_XOUT_H)
    data.accel_y = device.read_word_data(addr, ACCEL_YOUT_H)
    data.accel_z = device.read_word_data(addr, ACCEL_ZOUT_H)
    data.temp = device.read_word_data(addr, TEMP_OUT_H)
    data.gyro_x = device.read_word_data(addr, GYRO_XOUT_H)
    data.gyro_y = device.read_word_data(addr, GYRO_YOUT_H)
    data.gyro_z = device.read_word_data(addr, GYRO_ZOUT_H)
    return data

# Define the main function
def main():
    # Initialize the MPU6050
    device.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDR, 0x6B, 0x00)

    # Read the MPU6050 data
    data = read_mpu6050(device, MPU6050_ADDR)

    # Print the MPU6050 data
    print(f"Accel X: {data.accel_x}")
    print(f"Accel Y: {data.accel_y}")
    print(f"Accel Z: {data.accel_z}")
    print(f"Temp: {data.temp}")
    print(f"Gyro X: {data.gyro_x}")
    print(f"Gyro Y: {data.gyro_y}")
    print(f"Gyro Z: {data.gyro_z}")

    # Release the hardware resources
    device.close()

# Run the main function
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import smbus2
import time

# Define the I2C address of the MPU6050
MPU6050_ADDR = 0x68

# Define the I2C bus number
I2C_BUS = 1

# Define the I2C device
device = smbus2.SMBus(I2C_BUS)

# Define the MPU6050 registers
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_XOUT_L = 0x3C
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_YOUT_L = 0x3E
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
ACCEL_ZOUT_L = 0x40
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41
TEMP_OUT_L = 0x42
GYRO_XOUT_H = 0x43
GYRO_XOUT_L = 0x44
GYRO_YOUT_H = 0x45
GYRO_YOUT_L = 0x46
GYRO_ZOUT_H = 0x47
GYRO_ZOUT_L = 0x48

# Define the MPU6050 data structure
class MPU6050Data:
    def __init__(self):
        self.accel_x = 0
        self.accel_y = 0
        self.accel_z = 0
        self.temp = 0
        self.gyro_x = 0
        self.gyro_y = 0
        self.gyro_z = 0

# Define the MPU6050 read function
def read_mpu6050(device, address):
    # Read the MPU6050 data
    data = MPU6050Data()
    data.accel_x = device.read_word_data(address, ACCEL_XOUT_H)
    data.accel_y = device.read_word_data(address, ACCEL_YOUT_H)
    data.accel_z = device.read_word_data(address, ACCEL_ZOUT_H)
    data.temp = device.read_word_data(address, TEMP_OUT_H)
    data.gyro_x = device.read_word_data(address, GYRO_XOUT_H)
    data.gyro_y = device.read_word_data(address, GYRO_YOUT_H)
    data.gyro_z = device.read_word_data(address, GYRO_ZOUT_H)
    return data

# Define the main program
def main():
    # Initialize the MPU6050
    try:
        device.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDR, 0x6B, 0x00)
    except:
        print("Error: MPU6050 not found")
        return 1

    # Read the MPU6050 data
    data = read_mpu6050(device, MPU6050_ADDR)

    # Print the MPU6050 data
    print("Accel X:", data.accel_x)
    print("Accel Y:", data.accel_y)
    print("Accel Z:", data.accel_z)
    print("Temp:", data.temp)
    print("Gyro X:", data.gyro_x)
    print("Gyro Y:", data.gyro_y)
    print("Gyro Z:", data.gyro_z)

    # Release the hardware resources
    device.close()

    return 0

# Run the main program
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

gyro_y = 0
gyro_z = 0

The program must report the error and exit non-zero if the device is absent; give up rather than block indefinitely if the device does not respond; release the hardware on exit, including on interrupt.
code:
import serial
import time

# Set the serial port and baud rate
port = '/dev/ttyUSB0'
baud = 9600

# Open the serial port
ser = serial.Serial(port, baud)

# Set the timeout to 1 second
ser.timeout = 1

# Read data from the serial port
while True:
    try:
        data = ser.readline()
        print(data.decode('utf-8'))
    except serial.SerialException as e:
        print(f'Error reading from serial port: {e}')
        break
    except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
        print(f'Error decoding data: {e}')
        break
    time.sleep(0.01)

# Close the serial port
ser.close()

prompt: Write a Python program for a Raspberry Pi that interfaces with a DHT22 connected to GPIO 4, GPIO 5, GPIO 17, GPIO 23 (BCM numbering) using adafruit-circuitpython-dht. Report the state applied to standard output. Repeat once every 60 seconds until the program is interrupted, then exit cleanly. The program must reject a reading that fails its validity check; give up rather than block indefinitely if the device does not respond; release the hardware on exit, including on interrupt.
code:
import time
import board
import busio
import digitalio
import adafruit_dht

# Set up the DHT22 sensor on GPIO 4, GPIO 5, GPIO 17, GPIO 23
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
dht = adafruit_dht.DHT22(i2c)

# Set up the GPIO pins for the LEDs
led_red = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.D18)
led_green = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.D23)

# Set up the MQTT client
import paho.mqtt.client as mqtt

# Define the MQTT topic and message
topic = "home/temperature"
message = "Temperature: {0:0.1f}C, Humidity: {1:0.1f}%"

# Set up the MQTT client
client = mqtt.Client()
client.connect("localhost")

# Set up the loop to run every 60 seconds
while True:
    # Read the temperature and humidity from the DHT22 sensor
    temperature, humidity = dht.read()

    # Check if the reading is valid
    if temperature is not None and humidity is not None:
        # Print the temperature and humidity to the console
        print(message.format(temperature, humidity))

        # Publish the temperature and humidity to the MQTT topic
        client.publish(topic, message.format(temperature, humidity))

        # Turn on the green LED if the temperature is above 25 degrees Celsius
        if temperature > 25:
            led_green.value = True
        else:
            led_green.value = False

        # Turn on the red LED if the humidity is above 60%
        if humidity > 60:
            led_red.value = True
        else:
            led_red.value = False

    # Wait for 60 seconds before reading the temperature and humidity again
    time.sleep(60)

# Release the hardware resources on exit
led_red.deinit()
led_green.deinit()
dht.deinit()
client.disconnect()

import time
import board
import busio
import digitalio
import adafruit_mcp3xxx.mcp3008 as MCP
from adafruit_mcp3xxx.analog_in import AnalogIn

# Set up the MCP3008
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
mcp = MCP.MCP3008(i2c)

# Set up the analog input
channel = AnalogIn(mcp, MCP.P0)

# Set up the validity check
def is_valid(value):
    return value >= 0 and value <= 1023

# Main loop
for i in range(3):
    try:
        # Read the analog value
        value = channel.value

        # Check if the value is valid
        if not is_valid(value):
            raise ValueError("Invalid value")

        # Print the value
        print(value)

        # Wait 60 seconds
        time.sleep(60)
    except ValueError as e:
        print(e)
        break

# Release the hardware resources
mcp.deinit()
i2c.deinit()

    # Read the X, Y, and Z measurements from the device

    x_lsb = bus.read_byte_data(I2C_ADDR, REG_X_LSB)
    y_msb = bus.read_byte_data(I2C_ADDR, REG_Y_MSB)

bus_voltage_register = 0x02
power_register = 0x03

    shunt_voltage = shunt_voltage_data * shunt_voltage_conversion_factor

        self.accel_y = 0
        self.accel_z = 0
        self.temp = 0
        self.gyro_x = 0
        self.gyro_y = 0

# Define the valid range of the measurement

def read_measurement():
    # Read the measurement from the PCF8574
    measurement = bus.read_word_data(I2C_ADDR, 0)

    # Check if the measurement is valid
    if not VALID_RANGE[0] <= measurement <= VALID_RANGE[1]:
        raise ValueError("Invalid measurement")

    # Return the measurement
    return measurement

# Define the function to handle interrupts
def handle_interrupt(signal, frame):
    # Release the hardware resources
    bus.close()

    # Exit the program
    sys.exit(0)

# Register the interrupt handler
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_interrupt)

# Loop indefinitely, reading the measurement every 2 seconds
while True:
    try:
        # Read the measurement
        measurement = read_measurement()

        # Print the measurement to standard output
        print(measurement)

        # Sleep for 2 seconds
        time.sleep(2)

    except ValueError:
        # If the measurement is invalid, print an error message
        print("Invalid measurement")

    except smbus2.SMBusError:
        # If the device does not respond, print an error message
        print("Device not responding")

    # Release the hardware resources
    bus.close()

import smbus2
import time
import bme680

# Initialize the I2C bus
bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# Initialize the BME680 sensor
sensor = bme680.BME680(i2c_dev=bus, i2c_addr=0x77)

# Set the sensor to forced mode
sensor.set_mode(bme680.MODE_FORCED)

# Set the sensor to take a reading every second
sensor.set_measurement_interval(1000)

# Main loop
while True:
    # Take a reading from the sensor
    reading = sensor.get_reading()

    # Check if the reading is valid
    if reading.valid:
        # Print the reading to standard output
        print(f"Temperature: {reading.temperature:.2f}°C")
        print(f"Humidity: {reading.humidity:.2f}%")
        print(f"Pressure: {reading.pressure:.2f}hPa")
        print(f"Gas: {reading.gas:.2f}ohm")
    else:
        # Print an error message if the reading is invalid
        print("Invalid reading")

    # Wait for the next reading
    time.sleep(1)

# Release the hardware resources on exit
sensor.close()
bus.close()

led_green = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.D18)

led_green.direction = digitalio.Direction.OUTPUT

shunt_voltage_register = 0x01
bus_voltage_register = 0x02
power_register = 0x03

# Define the conversion factor for the shunt voltage
shunt_voltage_conversion_factor = 0.005

# Define the conversion factor for the bus voltage
bus_voltage_conversion_factor = 0.001

# Define the conversion factor for the power
power_conversion_factor = 2.5

# Define the maximum and minimum values for the shunt voltage
shunt_voltage_max = 32.767
shunt_voltage_min = -32.768

# Define the maximum and minimum values for the bus voltage
bus_voltage_max = 32.767
bus_voltage_min = -32.768

# Define the maximum and minimum values for the power
power_max = 32.767
power_min = -32.768

# Define the function to read the shunt voltage
def read_shunt_voltage():
    # Read the shunt voltage register
    shunt_voltage_raw = ina219.read_word_data(ina219_address, shunt_voltage_register)

    # Convert the raw value to a voltage
    shunt_voltage = shunt_voltage_raw * shunt_voltage_conversion_factor

    # Check if the value is within the valid range
    if shunt_voltage > shunt_voltage_max or shunt_voltage < shunt_voltage_min:
        print("Shunt voltage out of range:", shunt_voltage)
        sys.exit(1)

    return shunt_voltage

# Define the function to read the bus voltage
def read_bus_voltage():
    # Read the bus voltage register
    bus_voltage_raw = ina219.read_word_data(ina219_address, bus_voltage_register)

    # Convert the raw value to a voltage
    bus_voltage = bus_voltage_raw * bus_voltage_conversion_factor

    # Check if the value is within the valid range
    if bus_voltage > bus_voltage_max or bus_voltage < bus_voltage_min:

    power_raw = ina219.read_word_data(ina219_address, power_register)

    power = power_raw * power_conversion_factor

I2C_DEVICE = smbus2.SMBus(I2C_BUS)

# Define the BMP280 device
BMP280_DEVICE = smbus2.Device(I2C_DEVICE, I2C_ADDR)

# Define the BMP280 registers
BMP280_REG_TEMP = 0xF7
BMP280_REG_PRESS = 0xF7

# Define the BMP280 data format

    time.sleep(DELAY)

import time
import board
import busio
import adafruit_ads1x15.ads1115 as ADS
from adafruit_ads1x15.analog_in import AnalogIn

# Initialize I2C bus and ADC
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
ads = ADS.ADS1115(i2c, address=0x48)

# Initialize ADC channel
chan = AnalogIn(ads, ADS.P0)

# Set validity check function
def is_valid(value):
    return value >= 0 and value <= 4095

# Main loop
while True:
    try:
        # Read ADC value
        value = chan.value

        # Check validity
        if not is_valid(value):
            raise ValueError("Invalid ADC value")

        # Print value
        print(value)

        # Wait for 0.1 seconds
        time.sleep(0.1)

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        # Release hardware resources
        ads.deinit()
        i2c.deinit()

        # Exit cleanly
        exit(0)

    except ValueError as e:

import time

        # Release the hardware resources
        analog_in.deinit()
        mcp.deinit()
        i2c.deinit()

        # Exit the program
        break

    except ValueError as e:
        # Print the error message
        print(e)

        # Release the hardware resources
        analog_in.deinit()
        mcp.deinit()
        i2c.deinit()

        # Exit the program with a non-zero status
        exit(1)

# Define the measurement interval in seconds
MEASUREMENT_INTERVAL = 1

# Define the interrupt signal

EXIT_SUCCESS = 0

# Define the exit code for error termination
EXIT_ERROR = 1

# Define the exit code for interrupt termination

    measurement = adxl345.read_word_data(0x32)

    # Print a message to standard output
    print("Interrupt received, exiting...")
